statement.text:
For a finite group G let Cod(G) denote the set of irreducible character
codegrees of G (see 20.78). Define σ(G) = max{|π(m)| : m ∈ Cod(G)}, where π(m)
denotes the set of prime divisors of an integer m. It is proved that there exists
a constant k such that |π(G)| ⩽ k · σ(G) for every finite group G (Y. Yang, G. Qian,
J. Algebra, 478 (2017), 215–219), but the estimate provided for k is very crude. Can
the constant k be taken as 4?                                                G. Qian
